Meet Dr. Arnoud Noot

American Fork's leading biomimetic dentist, dedicated to preserving your natural teeth for life. Pronounced "Note" — easy to remember, impossible to forget.

Dr. Arnoud Noot, DDS

Dr. Arnoud Noot (pronounced "Note") has been practicing biomimetic dentistry in American Fork, Utah for over 18 years. He is recognized as "the most scientifically advanced dentist in the state of Utah" by the Academy of Biomimetic Dentistry.

A Different Philosophy

Dr. Noot believes it's better to protect a tooth than repair it. When repair is necessary, his biomimetic approach preserves your natural tooth structure instead of destroying it like traditional dentistry.

"I take the time to explain and show exactly what needs to be done," Dr. Noot explains. "My patients understand their treatment because I don't overbook my schedule. Each patient receives the time and attention they deserve."

The Biomimetic Difference

While other dentists drill aggressively and place crowns that eventually fail, Dr. Noot uses microscope precision and biomimetic materials to create restorations that mimic your natural tooth structure. This approach has allowed him to practice for over 18 years without placing a single crown.

Credentials & Training

Dr. Noot's advanced training and certifications ensure the highest level of biomimetic dental care:

Academy of Biomimetic Dentistry

Member of the prestigious Academy of Biomimetic Dentistry, trained directly by the founders of biomimetic dentistry.

American Dental Association (ADA)

Active member maintaining the highest standards of dental practice and continuing education.

Utah Dental Society

Contributing member of Utah's dental community, staying current with state regulations and best practices.

Air Force Dental Training

4 years of intensive dental training in the United States Air Force, developing precision and attention to detail.

Air Force Accommodation Medal

Awarded the Air Force Accommodation Medal for Meritorious Service, recognizing exceptional dedication to patient care.

18+ Years in American Fork

Nearly two decades serving American Fork and Utah County families with conservative, biomimetic dental care.

Dr. Noot's Conservative Approach

Unlike traditional dentistry that focuses on speed and volume, Dr. Noot takes a conservative, patient-centered approach that prioritizes your long-term oral health.

What Makes Dr. Noot Different:

No Overbooking

Dr. Noot doesn't overbook his schedule. Each appointment receives the full time and attention needed for comprehensive care.

Education-Focused

Every treatment includes education. You'll understand exactly what's happening and why each step is necessary.

Microscope Precision

Every procedure uses microscopy for unmatched accuracy. You can watch your treatment on screen.

Conservative Treatment

Dr. Noot preserves as much natural tooth structure as possible, avoiding unnecessary extractions and aggressive procedures.

Professional Recognition

Dr. Noot's expertise is recognized by colleagues and patients alike:
